Special Council Meeting - 11 June 2026

Thursday, June 11, 2026 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers, Derby

Join us for a Special Council Meeting at 5:30pm on Thursday 11 June 2026 in the Council Chambers, 31 Clarendon Street, Derby.

Purpose: 

  • Award of Tender T8-25/26 - Derby Civic Centre Building Work

The Public Notice is available HERE.

Disclaimer: Please note this meeting is being live streamed and recorded and will be made available on the Shire's website after the meeting. If you choose to participate in the meeting it is assumed your consent is given for the audio and visual to be recorded. You can watch the meeting live here:

Section 58 of the Local Government Amendment Act 2023 (the Amendment Act) inserts a new section 5.23A into the Local Government Act 1995 (the Act) covering requirements for electronic broadcasting (livestreaming) and video and audio recording of council meetings for Local Governments.

Special Council Meeting - 17 October 2024

Thursday, October 17, 2024 - 05:00 PM

Location: Derby Council Chambers - 31 Clarendon Street, Derby.

Special Council Meeting - Thursday, 17 October 2024 at 5:00pm

In accordance with Regulation 12(4) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, notice is given that a Special Council Meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, 17 October 2024 commencing at 5:00pm in the Derby Council Chamber - 31 Clarendon Street, Derby WA 6728.

Purpose:

Seeking Council’s endorsement for the Shire to pursue a role as an active participant in the development and management of new housing supply in the Shire to meet government (including Local Government), community and social housing requirements, including through submission through the State Government’s Housing Diversity Pipeline (HDP) Round 2 (HDP Round 2) Expression of Interest (EOI) process to register the Shire’s interest in acquisition of several government-owned, vacant or underutilised lots in the Derby Townsite.

Special Council Meeting

Friday, January 27, 2023 - 02:30 PM

Location: Derby Council Chambers

Special Council Meeting - 27 January 2023

Please join us in the Derby Council Chamber on Friday, 27 January 2023 at 2:30pm for a Special Meeting of Council.

In accordance with Regulation 12(2) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, notice is given that a Special Council Meeting has been scheduled for Friday, 27 January 2023 commencing at 2.30pm in the Derby Council Chamber - 30 Clarendon Street, Derby WA 6728.

Purpose:

  • For council to consider response, recovery and operational matter regarding AGRN1044 Ex - Tropical Cyclone Ellie and Associated Flooding December 2022.
